criteria.requirement: Implement icalendar.todo_transition.transition_todo for actual Todo objects with complete/reopen/cancel actions, returning an isolated same-class copy. Completion requires an explicit aware timestamp normalized to UTC and 100 percent; reopen clears COMPLETED and uses 0..99 progress/NEEDS-ACTION or IN-PROCESS; cancel clears completion and uses CANCELLED/zero. Validate progress and timestamps before publication, preserve UID/start/due and by-default SEQUENCE/DTSTAMP, offer explicit sequence bump/stamp, and never read a wall clock or send invitations.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
